title: Detailed yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="yoyoGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b9d"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#e84070"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#c2185b"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8e1550"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="axleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e0e0e0"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#b0b0b0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#808080"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="centerCap" cx="40%" cy="40%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff59d"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffd600"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffab00"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- String going up -->
  <path d="M50 50 L50 10 Q52 6 54 4" stroke="#dddddd" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="3" r="1.5" fill="#cccccc"/>

  <!-- Back disc shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="32" ry="34" fill="#6a0f3a"/>

  <!-- Left disc side -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="32" ry="34" fill="url(#yoyoGrad)"/>

  <!-- Right disc side (slightly offset to show thickness) -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="53" rx="32" ry="34" fill="url(#yoyoGrad)"/>

  <!-- Disc face left -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="54" rx="28" ry="30" fill="#f06292"/>

  <!-- Disc face right -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="53" rx="28" ry="30" fill="#ec407a"/>

  <!-- Rim highlight left -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="54" rx="28" ry="30" fill="none" stroke="#f8bbd0" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Decorative ring left -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="54" rx="22" ry="24" fill="none" stroke="#ffd54f" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Decorative ring right -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="53" rx="22" ry="24" fill="none" stroke="#ffd54f" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Inner decorative area left -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="54" rx="18" ry="20" fill="#f48fb1"/>

  <!-- Inner decorative area right -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="53" rx="18" ry="20" fill="#f06292"/>

  <!-- Spiral pattern on left face -->
  <path d="M48 64 Q36 58 40 48 Q44 40 54 44 Q60 48 56 56 Q52 62 46 58 Q42 54 46 50 Q50 47 53 50" 
        stroke="#ffd54f" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Spiral pattern on right face -->
  <path d="M52 63 Q40 57 44 47 Q48 39 58 43 Q64 47 60 55 Q56 61 50 57 Q46 53 50 49 Q54 46 57 49" 
        stroke="#ffd54f" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Center axle hub -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="6" ry="6.5" fill="url(#axleGrad)"/>

  <!-- Center cap -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="53" r="3.5" fill="url(#centerCap)"/>

  <!-- Tiny highlight on center cap -->
  <circle cx="49" cy="52" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Left disc edge detail -->
  <path d="M22 54 Q22 70 35 78" stroke="#880e4f" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Right disc edge detail -->
  <path d="M26 52 Q26 68 39 76" stroke="#880e4f" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Shine highlight -->
  <path d="M35 38 Q40 34 48 34" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.35" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 42 Q42 39 46 39" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.25" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Star decorations -->
  <polygon points="34,60 35,62 37,62 35.5,63.5 36,65.5 34,64 32,65.5 32.5,63.5 31,62 33,62" fill="#fff176"/>
  <polygon points="64,62 65,64 67,64 65.5,65.5 66,67.5 64,66 62,67.5 62.5,65.5 61,64 63,64" fill="#fff176"/>

  <!-- Small dots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="68" r="1.2" fill="#ffd54f"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="67" r="1.2" fill="#ffd54f"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="42" r="1" fill="#ffd54f"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="41" r="1" fill="#ffd54f"/>
</svg>
